description: Reduced zero-byte report left by a failed cell, followed by cross-language repair and genuine fitted-model exposure-offset recovery observed in a live count-analysis workflow. Synthetic observations; not an original model transcript.

cells.code:
records <- read.csv('inputs/counts.csv')
model <- stats::glm(y ~ x + offset(log(exposure)), data=records, family=stats::poisson(), control=stats::glm.control(epsilon=1e-12))
stopifnot(model$converged, inherits(model, 'glm'), stats::nobs(model)==6)
saveRDS(model, 'outputs/model.rds')
saveRDS(records, 'outputs/records.rds')
connection <- file('outputs/report.json', 'w')
close(connection)
writeLines('{"stage":"unreached"}', connection)

from pathlib import Path
import json
previous = Path('outputs/report.json').read_bytes()
assert previous == b''
Path('outputs/report.json').write_text(json.dumps({'stage': 'python-repaired'}), encoding='utf-8')

restored <- readRDS('outputs/model.rds')
records <- readRDS('outputs/records.rds')
stopifnot(inherits(restored, 'glm'), inherits(restored, 'lm'), restored$converged, stats::nobs(restored)==6)
newdata <- records[1, , drop=FALSE]
original <- stats::predict(restored, newdata=newdata, type='response')
newdata$exposure <- 2*newdata$exposure
doubled <- stats::predict(restored, newdata=newdata, type='response')
stopifnot(abs(original-2)<1e-8, abs(doubled-4)<1e-8, abs(doubled/original-2)<1e-10)
previous <- jsonlite::fromJSON('outputs/report.json')
stopifnot(identical(previous$stage, 'python-repaired'))
report <- jsonlite::toJSON(list(stage='r-restored', nobs=stats::nobs(restored), original=unname(original), doubled=unname(doubled)), auto_unbox=TRUE, digits=16)
writeLines(report, 'outputs/report.json')
cat('FAILED_NATIVE_OFFSET_RECOVERY_OK\n')
